tables.name: sales_quotes
tables.description: Quote objects with discount authority bands, totals and approval status (CPQ substrate).

tables.name: sales_quote_lines
tables.description: Quote line items with quantity, unit list price and line total.

tools.name: service_cases_list
tools.description: List service cases, optionally filtered by status, issue type, region, product, owner or account (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+Case).

status.description: Case status: open, escalated, pending_customer or closed.

issue_type.description: Issue type label from the issue taxonomy.

region.description: Service region the case belongs to.

product_code.description: Product the case was filed against.

owner_employee_id.description: Employee id of the case owner.

priority.description: Case priority: low, medium, high or critical.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: service_case_get
tools.description: Retrieve one service case by id (GET /services/data/v62.0/sobjects/Case/{id}).

tools.name: service_case_update_status
tools.description: Update a service case's status, priority or owner (PATCH /services/data/v62.0/sobjects/Case/{id}).

owner_employee_id.description: Employee id to assign the case to.

tools.name: case_history_list
tools.description: List case field-history rows, including ownership transfers (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+CaseHistory).

field_name.description: Field whose changes to return, e.g. OwnerId.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: case_messages_list
tools.description: List the chat transcript messages attached to a case (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+CaseComment).

speaker.description: Filter to Agent or Customer lines.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: product_catalog_list
tools.description: List catalog products with list prices (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+Product2).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: quotes_list
tools.description: List quotes, optionally by account, opportunity or approval status (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+Quote).

status.description: Quote status: draft, in_review, approved or rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: quote_lines_list
tools.description: List the line items on a quote (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+QuoteLineItem).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: quote_update_status
tools.description: Update a quote's approval status or discount (PATCH /services/data/v62.0/sobjects/Quote/{id}).

status.description: New status: draft, in_review, approved or rejected.

discount_pct.description: New discount percentage applied to the quote.

tools.name: customer_profile_get
tools.description: Retrieve a customer profile record, including PII and internal-only notes (GET /services/data/v62.0/sobjects/Account/{id}).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
